name: ballerinax/rabbitmq
description: RabbitMQ is a widely used open-source message broker that implements the Advanced Message Queuing Protocol (AMQP). It provides a reliable and scalable platform for asynchronous messaging, enabling decoupled communication between different components of a distributed system. The RabbitMQ connector provides a comprehensive API to interact with RabbitMQ, allowing you to manage exchanges, queues, and bindings, and to produce and consume messages efficiently.

functions.name: attach
functions.description:
Attaches the service to the `rabbitmq:Listener` endpoint.
```ballerina
check rabbitmqListener.attach(service, "serviceName");
```

parameters.name: s
parameters.description: The type descriptor of the service

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the service

return.description: `()` or else a `rabbitmq:Error` upon failure to register the service

functions.name: 'start
functions.description:
Starts consuming the messages on all the attached services.
```ballerina
check rabbitmqListener.'start();
```

functions.name: detach
functions.description:
Stops consuming messages and detaches the service from the `rabbitmq:Listener` endpoint.
```ballerina
check rabbitmqListener.detach(service);
```

parameters.name: s
parameters.description: The type descriptor of the service

return.description: `()` or else  a `rabbitmq:Error` upon failure to detach the service

functions.name: gracefulStop
functions.description:
Stops consuming messages through all consumer services by terminating the connection and all its channels.
```ballerina
check rabbitmqListener.gracefulStop();
```

return.description: `()` or else  a `rabbitmq:Error` upon failure to close the `ChannelListener`

functions.name: immediateStop
functions.description:
Stops consuming messages through all the consumer services and terminates the connection
with the server.
```ballerina
check rabbitmqListener.immediateStop();
```

return.description: `()` or else  a `rabbitmq:Error` upon failure to close ChannelListener.

functions.name: basicAck
functions.description:
Acknowledges one or several received messages.
```ballerina
check caller->basicAck(true);
```

parameters.name: multiple
parameters.description:
Set to `true` to acknowledge all messages up to and including the called on message and
`false` to acknowledge just the called on message

return.description: A `rabbitmq:Error` if an I/O error occurred

functions.description:
Rejects one or several received messages.
```ballerina

```

parameters.name: multiple
parameters.description:
Set to `true` to reject all messages up to and including the called on message and
`false` to reject just the called on message

parameters.name: requeue
parameters.description: `true` if the rejected message(s) should be re-queued rather than discarded/dead-lettered

return.description: A `rabbitmq:Error` if an I/O error is encountered or else `()`

functions.name: queueDeclare
functions.description:
Declares a non-exclusive, non-auto-delete, and durable queue with the given configurations.
```ballerina
check rabbitmqClient->queueDeclare("MyQueue");
```

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the queue

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: The configurations required to declare a queue

return.description:
`()` if the queue was successfully generated or else a `rabbitmq:Error`
if an I/O error occurred

functions.name: queueAutoGenerate
functions.description:
Declares a queue with a server-generated name.
```ballerina
string queueName = check rabbitmqClient->queueAutoGenerate();
```

return.description:
The name of the queue or else a `rabbitmq:Error`
if an I/O error occurred

functions.name: exchangeDeclare
functions.description:
Declares a non-auto-delete, durable exchange with no extra arguments.
If the arguments are specified, then the exchange is declared accordingly.
```ballerina
check rabbitmqClient->exchangeDeclare("MyExchange", rabbitmq:DIRECT_EXCHANGE);
```

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the exchange

parameters.name: exchangeType
parameters.description: The type of the exchange

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: The configurations required to declare an exchange

return.description: A `rabbitmq:Error` if an I/O error occurred or else `()`

functions.name: queueBind
functions.description:
Binds a queue to an exchange with the given binding key.
```ballerina
check rabbitmqClient->queueBind("MyQueue", "MyExchange", "routing-key");
```

parameters.name: queueName
parameters.description: The name of the queue

parameters.name: exchangeName
parameters.description: The name of the exchange

parameters.name: bindingKey
parameters.description: The binding key used to bind the queue to the exchange

return.description: A `rabbitmq:Error` if an I/O error occurred or else `()`

functions.name: publishMessage
functions.description:
Publishes a message. Publishing to a non-existent exchange will result in a channel-level
protocol error, which closes the channel.
```ballerina
check rabbitmqClient->publishMessage(messageInBytes, "MyQueue");
```

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: The message to be published

return.description: A `rabbitmq:Error` if an I/O error occurred or else `()`

functions.name: consumeMessage
functions.description:
Retrieves a message synchronously from the given queue providing direct access to the messages in the queue.
```ballerina
rabbitmq:AnydataMessage message = check rabbitmqClient->consumeMessage("MyQueue");
```

parameters.name: queueName
parameters.description: The name of the queue

parameters.name: autoAck
parameters.description: If false, should manually acknowledge

parameters.name: T
parameters.description: Optional type description of the required data type

return.description:
A `rabbitmq:AnydataMessage` object containing the retrieved message data or else a`rabbitmq:Error` if an
I/O error occurred

functions.name: consumePayload
functions.description:
Retrieves the payload synchronously from the given queue.
```ballerina
string message = check rabbitmqClient->consumePayload("MyQueue");
```

parameters.name: queueName
parameters.description: The name of the queue

parameters.name: autoAck
parameters.description: If false, should manually acknowledge

parameters.name: T
parameters.description: Optional type description of the required data type

return.description: Message payload in the required format if executed successfully or else a `rabbitmq:Error`

functions.name: basicAck
functions.description:
Acknowledges one or several received messages.
```ballerina
check rabbitmqClient->basicAck(<message|deliveryTag>);
```

parameters.name: ackTarget
parameters.description: The message to be acknowledged or the delivery tag of the message

parameters.name: multiple
parameters.description:
Set to `true` to acknowledge all messages up to and including the called on message and
`false` to acknowledge just the called on message

return.description: A `rabbitmq:Error` if an I/O error occurred or else `()`

functions.name: basicNack
functions.description:
Rejects one or several received messages.
```ballerina
check rabbitmqClient->basicNack(<message|deliveryTag>);
```

parameters.name: ackTarget
parameters.description: The message to be rejected or the delivery tag of the message

parameters.name: multiple
parameters.description:
Set to `true` to reject all messages up to and including the called on message and
`false` to reject just the called on message

parameters.name: requeue
parameters.description: `true` if the rejected message(s) should be re-queued rather than discarded/dead-lettered

return.description: A `rabbitmq:Error` if an I/O error occurred or else `()`

functions.name: queueDelete
functions.description:
Deletes the queue with the given name although it is in use or has messages in it.
If the `ifUnused` or `ifEmpty` parameters are given, the queue is checked before deleting.
```ballerina
check rabbitmqClient->queueDelete("MyQueue");
```

parameters.name: queueName
parameters.description: The name of the queue to be deleted

parameters.name: ifUnused
parameters.description: True if the queue should be deleted only if it's not in use

parameters.name: ifEmpty
parameters.description: True if the queue should be deleted only if it's empty

return.description: A `rabbitmq:Error` if an I/O error occurred or else `()`

functions.name: exchangeDelete
functions.description:
Deletes the exchange with the given name.
```ballerina
check rabbitmqClient->exchangeDelete("MyExchange");
```

parameters.name: exchangeName
parameters.description: The name of the exchange

return.description: A `rabbitmq:Error` if an I/O error occurred or else `()`

functions.name: queuePurge
functions.description:
Purges the content of the given queue.
```ballerina
check rabbitmqClient->queuePurge("MyQueue");
```

parameters.name: queueName
parameters.description: The name of the queue

return.description: A `rabbitmq:Error` if an I/O error occurred or else `()`

functions.name: close
functions.description:
Closes the `rabbitmq:Client`.
```ballerina
check rabbitmqClient->close();
```

parameters.name: closeCode
parameters.description:
The close code (for information, go to the [Reply Codes]
(#https://www.rabbitmq.com/resources/specs/amqp0-9-1.pdf))

parameters.name: closeMessage
parameters.description: A message indicating the reason for closing the channel

return.description: A `rabbitmq:Error` if an I/O error occurred or else `()`

functions.name: 'abort
functions.description:
Aborts the RabbitMQ `rabbitmq:Client`. Forces the `rabbitmq:Client` to close and waits for all the close operations
to complete. Any encountered exceptions in the close operations are discarded silently.
```ballerina
check rabbitmqClient->'abort(320, "Client Aborted");
```

parameters.name: closeCode
parameters.description:
The close code (for information, go to the [Reply Codes]
(#https://www.rabbitmq.com/resources/specs/amqp0-9-1.pdf))

parameters.name: closeMessage
parameters.description: A message indicating the reason for closing the channel

functions.name: retrieve
functions.description:
Retrieves the top message from the RabbitMQ message store without removing it. Retrieving
concurrently without acknowledgment will return the next message in the queue if the previous one
is not acknowledged.

return.description: The retrieved message, or `()` if the store is empty, or an error if an error occurs

removed from the store.

return.description: An error if the acknowledgment could not be processed, or `()`
